# __sce_dnas2_symbol11002 shim decrypts at runtime (mprotect RWX -> transform ->
# cacheflush -> mprotect RX). The cipher is reconstructed and the plaintext is
# readable (`python3 tools/dnas2_decrypt.py` writes the decrypted image).
# Each site also embeds 21 words of literal data plus 2 `b` placed inside
# the body (100 bytes per site) that gcc cannot emit from C: the build puts
# that scaffold in place of the markers of src/dnas/dnas_prot.h
# (tools/dnas_subst.py), and the gate compares the whole function with the
# decrypted image, descriptors masked (tools/dnas_ref.py). See
# docs/dnas.md.
